card.name: Dashes and dots inside phone numbers, section numbers
card.fires_on: Punctuation (hyphen, period, comma) right after a digit group, mainly in toll-free phone numbers and in section cross-references like 12.2 or 12.3.

modes.label: Phone number hyphens
modes.description: Hyphen inside a toll-free contact number given for information or reporting.

modes.label: Section number dots
modes.description: Period after 12 in a cross-reference to a Clinical Pharmacology section.

modes.label: Commas in lists of adjectives
modes.description: Comma after an adjective in short descriptive website blurbs.
